Definition: Set of adult social-organization states in the recoverable author S5 analysis archive (141 records, 65 printed species), including records excluded from the model for missing covariates. Incomplete relative to the reported 149 populations. Exact population locations are absent from this archive. One SG record conflicts with the publication and is held from the merge. Secondary field-literature synthesis, not new primary observations; citations retained. Counts of records are not numbers of individuals. States unioned without choosing a modal state.
